editorial.blurb: Mr. Kimchi serves up exceptional all-you-can-eat Korean BBQ with beautifully marbled meats, homemade sauces, and attentive service in a spacious, high-energy atmosphere.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for the Regular AYCE tier at $29.95 (or Premium at $34.95) and don't skip the Korean Fried Chicken side—it's exceptionally crunchy. The staff is incredibly attentive about grill changes and will help you nail cooking times if you're unsure.
